fusions.name: Wall Shove
fusions.desc: Drives everything near you back: deals 10 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocks them back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Discus Toss
fusions.desc: Hurls the head flat and spinning, dealing 28 damage to the first enemy it meets as a guaranteed critical hit.

fusions.name: Hold the Line
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 28 damage and holds for 8 seconds. It also hardens your armour by 10% while it stands.

fusions.name: Dent Ledger
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
